title: Setup, Accessories and Supply Replacement Schedule for Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
Setup and patient training are part of the rental or purchase payment in every payment class of Durable Medical Equipment Rentals; whether accessories and supplies are paid on top, and how often related supplies are replaced, depends on the class.

| Payment class | Setup and patient training included in the rental or purchase payment | Accessories and supplies paid separately | Replacement schedule for related supplies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment | Yes | No | Not applicable |
| Capped Rental Equipment | Yes | Yes | Not applicable |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | Yes | Yes | Mask every 3 months; cushions monthly; tubing every 3 months; filters twice monthly |
| Power Mobility Device | Yes | Yes | Batteries every 12 months |
| Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment | Yes | No | Not applicable |
| Frequently Serviced Equipment | Yes | No | Circuits monthly |
| Customized Equipment | Yes | Yes | Not applicable |

## Supplier notes

- No class pays setup or patient training apart from the rental or purchase payment.
- Accessories and supplies are paid separately for Capped Rental Equipment, Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment, Power Mobility Device and Customized Equipment, and are not paid separately for Inexpensive or Routinely Purchased Equipment, Oxygen and Oxygen Equipment and Frequently Serviced Equipment.
- Three classes carry a replacement schedule for related supplies: Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment (mask every 3 months, cushions monthly, tubing every 3 months, filters twice monthly), Power Mobility Device (batteries every 12 months) and Frequently Serviced Equipment (circuits monthly).

### Hypothetical reading

For a hypothetical Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment placement, the schedule gives a mask replacement every 3 months and a filter replacement twice in a month. For a hypothetical Frequently Serviced Equipment placement, the schedule gives a circuit replacement monthly, while accessories and supplies for that class are not paid separately.
